QR code guide: scanning, account details and printing for a shop

Reading time: 3 minutes · 14 October 2026

A QR code is a small square that hides a link, a number or some text. Our QR code generator makes one with the colours and logo you choose.

How to scan a QR code

Open your phone camera and point it at the code, then tap the notification that appears. A link opens the website, a WhatsApp code opens the chat, and a Wi-Fi code offers to join the network.

What kinds of QR can you make?

  • Link / text: a website or social page.
  • WhatsApp: a chat with your number, optionally with a ready message.
  • Wi-Fi: a guest joins without typing the password.
  • vCard: name, number and email saved as a contact.
  • Account details: name, bank and account number as plain text.

The account-details QR: an important difference

This QR only shows what you typed, and a customer can read it and copy the number. It is not an official payment QR issued by a bank. To pay, use the “Scan QR” option in your bank or wallet app with a QR issued by the bank, and for an official merchant QR contact your bank.

Print a poster for your shop

  1. Choose the type and fill in the details in the tool.
  2. Press “Print poster” and choose A4 or A5.
  3. Print it, laminate it and place it on the counter where customers can see it.
  4. Scan it with your own phone before using it.

To keep scanning easy

  • Keep the QR dark and the background light.
  • Keep any logo small and simple.
  • Do not make the text very long.
